meta.name: ulw-execute
meta.description: Executes a written ulw-plan work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger, worktree discipline, and parallel subagents. Use when the user says ulw-execute or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把写好的工作计划拆给多个子代理并行执行,并留下执行证据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有一份写好的工作计划,想让它被自动跑完
copy.tagline_en: Run a written work plan across parallel subagents and keep an evidence log
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you already have a written plan and want it executed for you

howto.what: Claude 会变成纯编排者：自己不改产品文件、不写代码，只选计划、拆分任务，把每个实现、测试、审查任务分派给子代理并行跑，并在 .omo/ 里维护 Boulder 状态、证据台账和计划勾选。
howto.when: 当你说出 ulw-execute，或要求运行 .omo/plans 下的计划文件时触发；若没有可执行的计划，它会先调用 ulw-plan 生成计划再开始执行。

say.note: 选计划并开始并行分派子代理

say.text: 用 $ulw-execute --make-pr 把每个阶段做成 PR
say.note: 每阶段推分支开 PR，不自动合并

say.text: $ulw-execute --ship 一路做到 PR 合并
say.note: 盯 CI 与评审，合并后清 worktree

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a pure orchestrator: it writes no code and edits no product files, only picks the plan, splits tasks, dispatches all implementation, test and review work to parallel subagents, and keeps .omo/ state.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say ulw-execute or ask to run a plan under .omo/plans; if no runnable plan exists it bootstraps ulw-plan first.

say_en.note: picks the plan and fans out subagents

say_en.text: Use $ulw-execute --make-pr to deliver each phase as a PR
say_en.note: pushes a branch and opens a PR per phase

say_en.text: $ulw-execute --ship all the way to a merged PR
say_en.note: watches CI and review, then cleans up
